name: toast
title: Toast
description: A brief message slides in and dismisses itself. Success, error, warning, and info feedback.
docs: ATOM UIKit ships global BEM classes. CSS files MUST be imported in a global stylesheet (e.g. app/globals.css) — do not convert them to CSS Modules. Foundations (tokens/foundation) are not installed via this shadcn channel; use the Atom MCP or full DS setup for design tokens. Tuning ranges and gotchas: see meta.agent when present.

webflow.exclude: runtime-only (portal imperativo, no produce HTML estático) — las notificaciones en Webflow van con el patrón del sitio, no con paste

gotchas.note: Mount <Toaster position="bottom-right" /> once at app root. Call toast()/toast.success|error|warning|info — not a declarative Toast tree.
Each toast is role=status aria-live=polite; default duration 4000ms (0 = sticky until dismiss).
